newsitem.title: USA: KeyCorp plans cellular phone for banking.
newsitem.headline: KeyCorp plans cellular phone for banking.

text.p: KeyCorp said it will start a pilot program in the Cleveland area next month to introduce its KeyMobile wireless product which will allow customers to conduct banking and investment transactions via cellular telephone.
Billing the product as the first cellular telephone that lets customers bank anywhere, KeyCorp said the introductory phase will target customers of its private banking division.
KeyCorp said the telephone can be used for electronic mail, and will allow users access to weather data and airline schedules.
Customers will also be able to make airline reservations with the device.
